name: oscillate_position_with_reversal
description: Advances a position field by a velocity field on each call; when the countdown in the same record is already zero it reverses the velocity and reloads the countdown, otherwise it decrements the countdown. It then adds a second offset field to the position.

name: load_indexed_global_and_call
description: Loads a word from a table selected by a word index register into a global variable and then calls another routine. The routine is also recorded as touching the DMA control register, whose bit 15 enables DMA channels.

name: enqueue_word_ring_entry
description: Copies the word at an input pointer into the slot chosen by a cyclic index and stores the input pointer advanced by one word in a parallel slot. It then advances the index by two and masks it so it cycles through four positions.

name: decrement_slot_and_step_back
description: Reads the value in the slot at the current index and, if it is nonzero, decrements that slot. When the slot reaches zero and the index is not at its start, it steps the index back by two, and it returns the value it read.

name: call_global_object_method
description: Reads a method offset from the object referenced by a global pointer and calls that method through the object's table. It passes no arguments and returns nothing itself.

name: forward_call_to_subroutine
description: Does nothing except call one other routine and return. It touches no data of its own, so it is a plain forwarding wrapper.

name: call_then_mark_state_four
description: Calls one other routine and then stores the byte value four in a field 28 bytes into the structure pointed to by an address register. The stored value records the state after the call.

name: release_held_object_reference
description: If a reference is held at offset 24, calls a method on it and, when that method reports success, decrements the 16-bit counter of the referenced object, trapping on signed overflow, and clears the held reference. It returns the method result, or minus one when nothing was held.

name: fill_empty_slot_from_helper
description: If the slot at offset 24 is empty, calls a helper routine and, on success, stores the address register output of that helper in the slot and clears the 32-bit word at offset 20. It returns the helper status, or minus one when the slot was already filled.

name: invoke_held_method_then_forward
description: If a value is held at offset 24, calls a method on the object in another register through its table. It then always calls one other routine.

name: clear_slot_then_set_state_two
description: Calls one other routine, then clears the 32-bit word at offset 24 and stores the byte value two at offset 28 in the same structure.

name: fill_empty_slot_from_helper
description: If the slot at offset 24 is empty, calls a different helper routine and, on success, stores its address register output in the slot and clears the 32-bit word at offset 20. It returns the helper status, or minus one when the slot was already filled.

name: accumulate_held_object_result
description: If an object is held in a slot, calls a method on it and, when the method reports success, adds the returned value to the 32-bit total at offset 20. It returns the method result, or minus one when no object is held.

name: chain_three_method_calls
description: Calls a method on one object, then a method on a second object reached through a field of a third structure, then a method on the third structure itself. Each call happens only if the previous one reported success, so the chain stops at the first failure.

name: decrement_three_reference_counts
description: Decrements the 16-bit counter at offset 4 inside two referenced structures, and inside a third one when that reference is set. Each decrement traps on signed overflow.

name: resolve_path_prefix_and_scan
description: Handles a text path: a leading backslash resolves it through a method on the current directory object, and a colon in the second character marks a device name that clears the directory. It records the resulting directory, scans the text to its terminator, and calls a global method table twice to store two results.

name: swap_or_finish_held_objects
description: When a new reference is passed in, it releases the one held at offset 6 by decrementing its counter and stores the new one there. Otherwise it calls methods on the references held at offsets 6, 10 and 14, chosen by a flag and by which references are held.

name: replace_or_finish_second_object
description: When a new reference is passed in, it releases the one held at offset 10 by decrementing its counter and stores the new one there. Otherwise it calls a method on the reference at offset 10, or a method on the one at offset 14 followed by a method on its result, depending on a flag and whether that reference is held.

name: finish_held_objects_by_flag
description: Calls a method on the reference at offset 10 when a flag is zero or the reference at offset 14 is not held. Otherwise it calls a method on the reference at offset 14 and then a second method on the result.

name: invoke_second_object_method
description: Calls one method on the reference held at offset 10 and returns. It performs no other work.

name: store_word_triple
description: Copies three consecutive 16-bit values from a source pointer into three consecutive 16-bit fields of a record at offset 30. It then returns the all-ones 32-bit constant.

name: reset_three_word_fields
description: Zeroes three consecutive 16-bit fields of a record at offset 30 and then calls another routine. It returns nothing.

name: read_long_field_at_offset
description: Returns the 32-bit value stored at offset 30 in the record passed through an address register.

name: mirror_or_clear_indexed_bit
description: For an input byte with its top bit clear, the low seven bits select a bit; if that bit is also set in a first bit array it sets the same bit in a second array, and the byte is returned. For an input with its top bit set, it clears the selected bit in the second array and returns zero.

name: clear_masked_bit_in_table
description: Clears one bit in a bit table at offset 48 of the record, with the byte chosen from the upper bits of a masked index and the bit chosen from its low three bits. It returns zero.

name: clear_four_long_fields
description: Zeroes four consecutive 32-bit fields at offset 48 of the record and then calls another routine. It returns nothing.

name: stub_return_only
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use; it does nothing.

name: initialize_record_from_bit_list
description: Stores a byte into the record, copies a signed word from the source list into four consecutive 32-bit fields, and toggles one bit in a bit array for each list entry until a negative terminator. It then calls another routine.

name: select_entry_pair_by_flag
description: Stores one of two pairs of entry values into the record, chosen by whether a flag byte is zero. It then calls another routine.

name: advance_stage_with_method_chain
description: When the stage counter equals one, it calls methods on three referenced objects in order and returns the failure value at the first that reports failure, running a cleanup method on the second object if the third fails. If all succeed it decrements a counter in one object, calls a helper, and decrements the stage counter; otherwise it just decrements the stage counter and returns zero.

name: locate_chained_table_entry
description: Computes a block number by ceiling division of an offset by a product of two record fields, then follows a chain table to the matching link. It either clears that link and calls a routine, or calls a routine and stores its result in the link, and then calls a method on each entry of a run at a fixed stride until one fails.

name: walk_chain_and_store_result
description: Walks a chain table from a starting index for a counted number of steps, stopping at a negative link. Depending on the outcome it either clears the link and calls a routine, or calls a routine and stores its result in the link, and then calls a method on each entry of a run at a fixed stride until one fails.

name: store_slot_and_visit_run
description: Stores a 16-bit value into a table slot at a given offset, then steps through a run of entries at a fixed stride, calling a method on each until one reports failure.

name: mark_slot_and_visit_run
description: When the slot offset is nonzero it writes a negative sentinel into the slot, otherwise it sets the return value to zero. It then calls a routine and steps through a run of entries calling a method on each, returning the stored value when the run ends or the failure code when a method reports failure.

name: mark_slot_sentinel_and_visit
description: Writes a negative sentinel into a table slot at a given offset, calls a routine, and then steps through a run of entries calling a method on each until one reports failure.

name: visit_run_until_failure
description: Repeatedly steps a position by a stride and calls a method on the object at offset 14 for each step, for a counted number of steps. It stops at the first call that reports failure.

name: link_zero_cells_into_chain
description: Scans a block of 16-bit cells for zero entries and writes into each one the index of the previously linked zero cell, building a chain. If a non-zero cell is reached before the count runs out, it calls a routine and returns.

name: chain_zero_cells_counted
description: Advances through a block of 16-bit cells past non-zero entries, up to a counted limit, and at each zero cell it writes the previous link index and advances the link. It returns after the requested number of links, or calls a routine when the scan runs out of cells with a non-negative link.

name: call_routine_if_nonnegative
description: Calls another routine only when a 16-bit value passed in a data register is nonnegative, and otherwise returns without doing anything.

name: clear_linked_cell_chain
description: Follows a chain of 16-bit links starting from a table index, zeroing each visited cell, and stops when it reaches a negative link.

name: attach_object_and_reset_stage
description: Stores a flag byte and an object reference in the record, increments the reference counters of that object and of a global object, and clears the 16-bit stage counter. It then calls another routine.

name: compare_byte_to_stored_flag
description: Compares the byte in a data register with the flag byte stored at offset 36 in the record. It returns all ones when they match and zero otherwise.

name: run_stage_validate_and_walk
description: At stage zero it calls methods on the object at offset 14, checks a tag word in the returned block against a fixed value, walks that block's entries calling a method on each, and then acquires and calls methods on a second object. At later stages it calls a method on the object at offset 32, increments that object's counter, and advances the stage counter.

name: forward_call_to_subroutine
description: Does nothing except call one other routine and return. It touches no data of its own, so it is a plain forwarding wrapper.

name: invoke_slot_object_method
description: Calls one method on the object referenced at offset 26 in the record and returns nothing.

name: forward_call_to_subroutine
description: Does nothing except call one other routine and return. It touches no data of its own, so it is a plain forwarding wrapper.

name: walk_grid_cells_until_failure
description: Converts a linear offset into a row and column using the block width and block count fields, then advances through the grid cells, following chain links at the end of each row. It calls a method on the referenced object at each step and stops when a call fails or the remaining distance is used up.

name: decrement_counter_after_method
description: When the word at offset 44 equals one, it calls a method on the object at offset 46 and returns the failure code if that method reports failure. Otherwise, or after a successful call, it decrements the word at offset 44 and returns zero.

name: run_paired_method_sequence
description: Calls setup methods on two objects in turn and, when the first call fails, checks two flag bits in the argument and may try a fallback sequence on the same objects. It then calls a finishing method on the second object, decrements the reference counters of the objects it used, and returns the status.

name: run_method_chain_with_fallback
description: Calls a method on one object and then a chain of methods on a second object, with a fallback on the second object when a call fails. It then calls a finishing method on a third object, decrements reference counters, and returns the status of the last call that ran.

name: clear_long_field_then_call
description: Zeroes the 32-bit field at offset 36 in the record and then calls another routine. It returns nothing.

name: store_reference_and_init_stage
description: Stores an object reference at offset 46, calls another routine, and decrements the 16-bit counter at offset 4 with signed overflow trapping. It then sets the stage counter to one and fills two more fields with fixed values.

name: increment_counter_return_zero
description: Increments the 16-bit counter at offset 44 in the record and returns zero.

name: stub_return_minus_one
description: Routine consisting only of a return of the all-ones 32-bit constant, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use; it does nothing else.

name: invoke_secondary_object_method
description: Calls one method on the object referenced at offset 50 in the record and returns nothing.

name: release_secondary_object_then_call
description: Decrements the 16-bit counter of the object referenced at offset 50, trapping on signed overflow, and then calls another routine.

name: acquire_secondary_object_after_call
description: Calls another routine, then calls a method on the global table entry to obtain an object, stores that object at offset 50, and sets the byte at offset 25 to four.

name: run_sequence_or_mask_check
description: When a method on the first object returns zero, it runs a sequence of methods on the held objects and decrements reference counters. Otherwise it returns minus one, unless the input mask matches the byte at offset 25 in the record, in which case it calls a method, increments a counter and returns zero.

name: invoke_secondary_object_method_b
description: Calls a second method on the object referenced at offset 50 in the record and returns nothing.

name: call_global_object_method
description: Reads a method offset from the object referenced by a global pointer and calls that method through the object's table. It passes no arguments and returns nothing itself.

name: run_counted_step_two_methods
description: When the word at offset 44 equals one, it calls a method on the object at offset 46 and returns the failure code if that call fails. Otherwise it calls two methods on the object at offset 36, and in every completed case it decrements the word at offset 44 and returns zero.

name: invoke_method_when_counter_one
description: When the word at offset 44 equals one, it returns the result of a method on the object in another register; otherwise it returns minus one.

name: stub_return_only
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use; it does nothing.

name: run_masked_method_and_count
description: Calls a method on the object in an address register and, when it returns nonzero and the input mask overlaps the byte at offset 25 in the record, calls a method on the record, increments its counter and returns zero. Otherwise it returns minus one.

name: decrement_held_object_then_call
description: Decrements the 16-bit counter of the object referenced at offset 46, trapping on signed overflow, and then calls another routine.

name: acquire_held_object_and_reset
description: Calls another routine, then calls a method on the object at offset 36 to obtain a reference, stores it at offset 46 and increments its counter. It also sets the byte at offset 25 to two and clears the word at offset 44.

name: run_first_step_and_count
description: When the word at offset 44 is zero, it calls two methods on the object at offset 36. It then increments the word at offset 44 and returns zero.

name: clamp_request_against_limit
description: When the requested amount exceeds the room left between a position and the limit at offset 32, it returns zero. Otherwise it calls a method on the object at offset 46 and returns the requested amount on success or the failure code.

name: finish_pair_and_release_refs
description: Calls a method on one object and another on a second object, then decrements the reference counters of the objects involved. It returns the result of a further method call only when the second call reported failure, and otherwise returns minus one.

name: invoke_object_method_direct
description: Calls one method on the object held in a register directly, with no arguments, and returns nothing.

name: release_object_at_36_if_held
description: If an object is held at offset 36, it decrements that object's 16-bit counter, trapping on signed overflow. Otherwise it does nothing.

name: reset_or_copy_text_fields
description: When the source pointer is null, it fills a 10-byte text field at offset 14 with space characters and clears two fields. Otherwise it copies a 21-byte text field from the source record and takes its object reference and value at offset 40.

name: compare_flagged_text_fields
description: When the combined flag byte is nonzero, it compares ten bytes of text at offset 14 in the two records and returns all ones if they match. The low part of the result holds the remaining comparison count.

name: verify_held_method_code
description: Calls a method on the object held at offset 36 and returns its result when that result equals twenty-two, otherwise it returns minus one.

name: read_long_value_field
description: Returns the 32-bit value stored at offset 32 in the record.

name: store_flag_then_run_methods
description: Stores a flag byte at offset 59 in the record, calls a method on the object in an address register, then calls another routine and a method on the object referenced by the record's first field.

name: call_global_method_after_flag_check
description: Checks two flag bits in the record but selects the same global object in every case, then calls one method on it. It returns nothing.

name: clear_long_counter_field
description: Zeroes the 32-bit field at offset 44 in the record and returns.

name: release_three_refs_when_done
description: Decrements the 16-bit field at offset 6, and when it reaches zero and a method on the object in another register succeeds, calls another method there and decrements the reference counters of the objects at offsets 14, 18 and 22.

name: invoke_paired_objects_method
description: Calls a method on the object at offset 18, then calls the same method slot on the object at offset 22, passing the record to the second call.

name: run_guarded_sequence_then_release
description: When a method on the object in an address register returns nonzero, it calls two methods on that object and one method on a second object, then decrements the reference counter of the object left in another register. Otherwise it does nothing.

name: store_long_and_word_fields
description: Stores a 32-bit value and a 16-bit value into two fields of the record at offsets 10 and 8, and clears the 16-bit field at offset 6. It performs no other operations.

name: acquire_three_objects_and_loop
description: When the state word at offset 6 is zero, it obtains three objects from the global table and stores them at offsets 14, 18 and 22. It then runs a counted loop that calls a method on the global table and a method on the object at offset 14, decrements a reference counter, and finally sets the state word to one.

name: forward_call_to_subroutine
description: Does nothing except call one other routine and return. It touches no data of its own, so it is a plain forwarding wrapper.

name: invoke_object_method_at_22
description: Calls one method on the object referenced at offset 22 in the record and returns nothing.

name: run_checked_sequence_with_status
description: When a method on the object in an address register returns nonzero, it calls a method there and, if that succeeds, calls two more methods and decrements a reference counter. It returns zero on completion, or the failure code of the middle call.

name: forward_call_to_subroutine
description: Does nothing except call one other routine and return. It touches no data of its own, so it is a plain forwarding wrapper.

name: find_first_object_and_dispatch
description: Calls a lookup method on each referenced object in turn until one returns an object, and returns a dispatched result directly when the input equals a stored value. The chosen object gets a method call, and on failure cleanup methods run and a reference counter is decremented, otherwise it finishes with a method call and returns zero.

name: invoke_method_if_result_nonzero
description: Calls a method on the object in an address register and, when the result is nonzero, calls a second method on that same object. It returns nothing.

name: release_held_reference_at_18
description: If an object is held at offset 18, it clears that reference and decrements the object's 16-bit counter, trapping on signed overflow.

name: invoke_object_method_then_forward
description: Calls one method on the object in an address register and then calls another routine.

name: store_helper_result_and_clear
description: Calls another routine and stores its address register output at offset 14 in the record, then clears the 32-bit field at offset 18.

name: match_held_reference_and_index
description: Returns all ones when the address register value is minus one or equals the reference held at offset 18, and the data register word is negative or equals the word at offset 22. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: copy_bytes_from_held_block
description: Copies bytes from the block referred to by the pointer at offset 14, starting at a given displacement, into a destination buffer. It copies one more byte than the requested count.

name: hold_reference_and_invoke_method
description: Stores an object reference at offset 18 and increments its counter, saves a word at offset 22, and then calls a method on the held object.

name: invoke_held_object_method_b
description: Calls one method on the object held at offset 18 and returns nothing.

name: call_method_if_both_held
description: When this record and the record in an address register both hold an object at offset 14, calls a method on the register object. It then calls another routine and a second method on the register object.

name: copy_reference_field_after_call
description: Calls a method on the global table entry, then copies the 32-bit reference at offset 18 from this record into the record in the address register returned by that call.

name: read_device_letter_from_path
description: If the text referred to by the pointer at offset 6 has a length above one and its second character is a colon, it returns the first character. Otherwise it returns all ones.

name: forward_then_invoke_method
description: Calls another routine and then calls one method on the object in an address register, passing no arguments.

name: invoke_method_and_store_long
description: Calls one method on the object in an address register, then stores the 32-bit value in a data register into the record at offset 18.

name: call_and_normalize_status
description: Calls one routine, then another, and returns the second routine's status. A nonnegative status is replaced by zero when the flag byte in a data register is zero.

name: copy_path_component_padded
description: Copies the characters of a path component into a fixed-width buffer, stopping at a terminator, separator or dot, and then skips any remaining characters of that component. A wildcard character instead causes the rest of the buffer to be filled with question marks.

name: check_indexed_byte_nonzero
description: Reads a byte from the buffer at the pointer stored at offset 6, indexed by the value at offset 18. It returns zero when that byte is nonzero and minus one when it is zero.

name: set_path_form_status
description: Sets a status value of zero, two or three in the record at offset 18, depending on the length of the text at the pointer in the record and whether its second character is a colon and its third character is nonzero.

name: finish_stage_when_active
description: When the stage word at offset 28 equals one, it clears the byte at offset 26 and calls another routine, after a method on the object in an address register if the flag byte at offset 36 is set; a failing method stops the routine early. The stage word is then decremented.

name: store_word_then_call
description: Stores the 16-bit value from a data register at offset 38 in the record and then calls another routine.

name: initialize_stage_from_entry
description: When the stage word at offset 28 is zero, it calls a routine and a helper, then if the flag at offset 26 is clear it copies the fields of a looked-up entry into the record when the entry has a fixed tag value, and computes a quotient from them. It then stores a helper result at offset 30, clears the flag at offset 36 and sets the word at offset 34 to minus one. In all cases it calls one more routine and returns its status.

name: store_word_and_run_checked
description: Stores a 16-bit value at offset 34 and clears the flag byte at offset 36, then calls another routine. If that routine reports failure, the word at offset 34 is reset to minus one.

name: clear_flag_after_helper
description: Calls one helper routine, clears the flag byte at offset 36 in the record, and returns zero.

name: clear_stage_word_after_call
description: Calls another routine and then clears the 16-bit stage word at offset 28 in the record. It returns nothing.

name: advance_stage_with_first_method
description: When the stage word at offset 28 is zero, it calls one method on the object in an address register. It then increments the stage word.

name: forward_call_to_helper
description: Does nothing except call one helper routine and return. It touches no data of its own, so it is a plain forwarding wrapper.

name: initialize_control_block
description: Stores its register arguments and a flag byte in a control block, obtains a memory block from a helper and lays out its sub-areas, and writes a return entry at the top of that block. It clears a run of fields, then raises a system trap and returns the address register input.

name: match_text_prefix_to_stored
description: Compares the zero-terminated text at an address register with the stored text at offset 120 of the record. It returns all ones when the input ends while every character so far matches, and zero at the first difference.

name: merge_mask_bits_and_check
description: Calls a method on the global object and ORs its returned bits into a 32-bit mask field in the record. When that mask overlaps a second mask field it returns the flag byte from the record, and the routine is bracketed by two system traps.

name: store_global_offset_pointer
description: Stores the global base address plus a data register offset into offset 16 of the record, bracketed by system traps.

name: clear_and_read_guarded_slot
description: Between system traps, it clears a 32-bit field, sets a flag bit in the byte at offset 15, and returns the 32-bit value at offset 116. It raises an error trap when that value is nonzero or flag bit zero is set.

name: clear_requested_mask_bits
description: Calculates which requested bits are set in a 32-bit mask field and clears those bits from it, raising a trap first when none of them were set. It is bracketed by two system traps.

name: call_stored_entry_point
description: Calls the routine whose entry address is stored at offset 20 in the record, passing no arguments.

name: store_argument_and_call_method
description: Stores a flag byte and an address argument in the record, then calls a method on the object in another register. When that method returns a nonzero value it replaces the stored address with it, and it returns the method result.

name: call_stored_entry_at_24
description: Calls the routine whose entry address is stored at offset 24 in the record, passing no arguments.

name: call_first_node_entry_if_linked
description: Follows the first link from the record and, when that node has a successor, calls the entry routine stored at offset 16 of the node. It then returns.

name: store_node_fields_with_flag
description: Stores two 32-bit values and a 16-bit value into the record at offsets 10, 14 and 18, then clears the flag byte at offset 20. The flag byte gets its low bit set when the 16-bit input is nonzero.

name: allocate_node_and_dispatch
description: Obtains a node from one of two helpers chosen by the low bit of the flag byte, and returns zero when none was obtained. Otherwise it links the node to the object at offset 10 and marks it, then either walks the list at offset 14 and makes an indirect call chosen by a byte from its last entry, or calls a method on the node.

name: copy_packed_long_then_dispatch
description: Copies a 32-bit value from a small packed record into the destination at an offset given by two of its bytes. It then makes an indirect call chosen by another byte of that record.

name: copy_packed_word_then_dispatch
description: Copies a 16-bit value from a small packed record into the destination at an offset given by two of its bytes. It then makes an indirect call chosen by another byte of that record.

name: dispatch_by_byte_or_method
description: If a pointer argument is supplied, makes an indirect call selected by the byte it points to. Otherwise it calls a method on the object in an address register.

name: unlink_double_linked_node
description: Joins the two neighbouring nodes referenced at offsets 6 and 10 of the record so that each points past this node, then clears those two references in the record.

name: store_byte_field_at_14
description: Stores the byte value from a data register into the record at offset 14 and returns.

name: append_char_to_text_buffer
description: Appends a byte to a length-tracked text buffer: when the length reaches the capacity at offset 10 it first calls a method on the object in another register. It then writes the byte, keeps a terminating zero after it, and increments the length at offset 14.

name: append_text_from_object
description: Adds the length reported by a method on the object in an address register to the text length at offset 14, grows the buffer through a method on the record when it becomes full, and copies the zero-terminated text returned in an address register onto the end of the buffer.

name: call_global_object_method
description: Reads a method offset from the object referenced by a global pointer and calls that method through the object's table. It passes no arguments and returns nothing itself.

name: grow_text_buffer_and_copy
description: Sets a new capacity from a requested size, or grows the current capacity by half when the request is minus one. It then obtains a new buffer from a helper, copies the zero-terminated text into it, switches the record to that buffer and releases the old one through another helper.

name: copy_text_into_new_buffer
description: Sizes a new text buffer from a requested length, or from the length of the input text when the length is negative, and obtains it from a helper. It copies the input text into the buffer with a zero terminator and records the buffer and its length in the record.

name: read_text_length_field
description: Returns the 32-bit value stored at offset 14 in the record.

name: insert_node_by_key_byte
description: Increments the counter of the node passed in an address register, walks the list in the record until it finds a node whose key byte at offset 14 is lower than the new node's key, and splices the new node after it. The neighbour links are rewritten to match.

name: insert_node_at_front
description: Increments the counter of the node in an address register and inserts it at the front of the list headed in this record, rewriting the neighbour links. The old head becomes the node's successor.

name: insert_node_at_front
description: Increments the counter of the node in an address register and inserts it at the front of the list headed in this record, rewriting the neighbour links. The old head becomes the node's successor.

name: append_node_at_stored_tail
description: Increments the counter of the node in an address register, links it after the tail node stored at offset 14 in this record, and makes it the new tail. Its back link points into the record.

name: call_method_on_each_node
description: Walks a linked list starting at the record's first link and calls one method, selected by an offset in a data register, on every node that has a successor. It returns nothing.

name: call_method_until_nonzero
description: Walks the list headed in the record and calls a method chosen by an offset register on each node that has a successor. It stops at the first nonzero result and returns it, or returns zero when every result is zero.

name: test_single_node_list
description: Returns minus one when the node reached through the record's first link has no successor, and zero otherwise.

name: call_method_until_hit_and_count
description: Walks the list in the record and calls a method on each node that has a successor until one returns nonzero. It then increments that node's counter and returns the result, or returns zero when no node responds.

name: clear_list_and_reset_head
description: Decrements the counter of each node in the list headed in the record, leaving the last node unchanged. It then points the list head and tail links back at the record's own fields.

name: release_chain_and_reset_list
description: Walks a chain of nodes starting at the node in a data register, decrementing the counter of each visited node. It then points the list head and tail links of the record back at its own fields.

name: decrement_list_counters
description: Decrements the counter of each node in the list headed in the record, except the last node, and returns.

name: touch_first_node_if_linked
description: Returns the forward link of the first node in the record's list. When that link is nonzero it also increments the counter of the first node.

name: initialize_list_head
description: Points the list head link and the tail link of the record at the record's own fields and clears the 32-bit field at offset 10.

name: insert_node_by_predicate
description: Increments the counter of the node in an address register and calls a method on it to obtain a code address. It then calls that code address on each node of the list in the record until one returns a positive value, and splices the node in after that point.

name: unlink_node_and_decrement
description: Unlinks the node in an address register by joining its two neighbours, clears its two link fields, and decrements its 16-bit counter with signed overflow trapping.

name: pop_tail_node
description: If the tail node has a predecessor, makes that predecessor the new tail, copies the old tail's forward link into it, and clears the old tail's two link fields.

name: count_list_entries
description: Counts the nodes reached by following links from the record's first link until the list ends, and returns that count.

name: count_nodes_from_start
description: Adds one for each node reached by following forward links from the node in a data register, starting from the value of another data register, and returns the total.

name: patch_call_sites_with_jumps

name: clear_low_memory_long_words

name: install_code_patches_by_mode
description: Returns early when a word in the record is nonzero. Otherwise it chooses one of two sets of fixed code addresses according to a mode value and writes jump and call words into them, also saving a value from the stack.

name: install_code_patches_by_flag
description: Chooses one of two sets of fixed code addresses according to a mode value and writes jump and call words into them. It returns the two data register inputs unchanged.

name: install_code_patches_default
description: Writes jump and call words into a fixed set of code addresses, replacing one site with two no-operation words. It returns its stack argument unchanged.

name: call_global_method_then_indirect

name: start_and_parse_command_line

name: close_library_and_reply_message

name: call_two_library_functions

name: open_dos_library_or_fail

name: invoke_optional_handle_routines

name: store_arguments_and_call_helpers
description: Stores its two arguments into two global variables, then calls one helper with a fixed set of arguments that includes a global address and constants. It then calls a second helper with a single constant.

name: open_resources_and_load_keymap
description: Opens the libraries, devices and keymap resource it needs and reports the stored error strings for a missing signal, device, library or ROM version. It then takes a keymap name from the command line or the icon tool types, looks it up among installed keymaps, and loads it from the DEVS keymaps directory with LoadSeg when it is absent.

name: pass_params_to_subroutine
description: Calls another routine with a global value, its parameter and the address of an eight-byte stack slot.

name: call_global_library_function
description: Calls one library function through a library base read from a global variable at a fixed offset, passing no arguments, and returns.

name: format_text_and_write_output
description: Formats text into a 140-byte stack buffer through the exec library formatting function, then measures the string length. When the length is nonzero it passes the buffer and length to another routine that writes through the dos library.

name: copy_sixteen_longs_then_call

name: open_two_handles_and_configure
